falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at 5,119; a 6% lower break shows this is not a comparable accumulation structure but rather a breakdown into a deeper bear phase

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking at 38.57 then rapidly mean-reverting; sustained elevated fear above 35 indicates panic-driven liquidation rather than the controlled capitulation and bottoming process implied by the pattern match

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid this aggressive would signal recession/depression pricing, invalidating the 'bottom' thesis which requires rates stabilizing or rising modestly to reflect growth expectations; August 2024 bottom saw 10Y yields bottom at 3.78% before reversing sharply higher

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
